en: Black‑and‑white image of a large indoor swimming pool crowded with bathers in early 20th‑century swimwear. Spectators sit and stand on an upper gallery that runs around the pool. A slide descends from the gallery into the water on the right. Warning and depth signs are posted on the walls. At the bottom edge of the image there is a caption identifying the scene as an indoor bathing facility at Long Beach.
